stem: Which key idea is best supported by information in paragraphs 4 through 6?

options.label: A
options.text: Tourism is the major industry in La Gomera.

options.label: B
options.text: El Silbo is more difficult to learn than most other languages.

options.label: C
options.text: The people of La Gomera have differing ideas about the value of el Silbo.

options.label: D
options.text: Earning a living is easier now than in the past for the people of La Gomera.
